records.literal_gloss: And it was in [the] eightieth year and four hundred year after [the] going out of [the] sons of Israel from [the] land of Egypt, in the year the fourth, in [the] month of Ziv, that [is] the month the second, of [the] reigning of Solomon over Israel, and he built the house for Yahweh.

en.L: And it came about in the 480th year after the going out of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fourth year, in the month of Ziv, that [is] the second month, of Solomon's reigning over Israel, that he built the house for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: In the 480th year after the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} came out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year that Solomon reigned over Israel, in the month of Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Solomon began to build the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the fourth year that he ruled over Israel. It was in the month of Ziv, the second month of the year, in spring. This was 480 years after the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} came out of Egypt.

es.L: Y sucedió en el año cuatrocientos ochenta después de la salida de los hijos de Israel de la tierra de Egipto, en el cuarto año, en el mes de Ziv, que [es] el mes segundo, del reinado de Salomón sobre Israel, que edificó la casa {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: En el año cuatrocientos ochenta después de que los israelitas salieron de la tierra de Egipto, en el cuarto año del reinado de Salomón sobre Israel, en el mes de Ziv, que es el segundo mes, comenzó a edificar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Salomón comenzó a construir el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en el cuarto año de su reinado sobre Israel. Fue en el mes de Ziv, el segundo mes del año, en primavera. Esto ocurrió cuatrocientos ochenta años después de que los israelitas salieron de Egipto.

fr.L: Et il arriva, en la quatre cent quatre-vingtième année après la sortie des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël du pays d’Égypte, la quatrième année, au mois de Ziv, qui [est] le deuxième mois, du règne de Salomon sur Israël, qu’il bâtit la maison pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: La quatre cent quatre-vingtième année après la sortie d’Égypte des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, la quatrième année du règne de Salomon sur Israël, au mois de Ziv, qui est le deuxième mois, il commença à bâtir la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Salomon a commencé à construire le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} la quatrième année de son règne sur Israël. C’était au mois de Ziv, le deuxième mois de l’année, au printemps. Il s’était passé 480 ans depuis que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} étaient sortis d’Égypte.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwaka wa mia nne na themanini baada ya kutoka kwa wana wa Israeli katika nchi ya Misri, katika mwaka wa nne, katika mwezi wa Zivu, [ndio] mwezi wa pili, wa kutawala kwake Sulemani juu ya Israeli, akaijenga nyumba kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

sw.R: Sulemani alianza kujenga hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wake juu ya Israeli. Ilikuwa katika mwezi wa Zivu, mwezi wa pili wa mwaka, wakati wa majira ya kuchipua. Hiyo ilikuwa miaka mia nne na themanini baada ya Waisraeli kutoka Misri.

vi.L: Vào năm thứ 480 sau khi con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, năm thứ tư, vào tháng Xíp, tức là tháng thứ hai, của triều Sa-lô-môn trên Y-sơ-ra-ên, vua xây nhà cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vào năm thứ 480 sau khi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, năm thứ tư Sa-lô-môn trị vì Y-sơ-ra-ên, vào tháng Xíp, tức là tháng thứ hai, vua khởi công xây nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn khởi công xây đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào năm thứ tư vua cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên. Lúc ấy là tháng Xíp, tháng thứ hai trong năm, vào mùa xuân. Đó là 480 năm sau khi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 이집트 땅에서 나온 지 480년째 되는 해, 솔로몬이 이스라엘을 다스린 지 4년째 되는 해 시브월, 곧 둘째 달에, 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 집을 지었다.

ko.R: 솔로몬은 이스라엘을 다스린 지 4년째 되는 해에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 짓기 시작했다. 그때는 그해의 둘째 달인 시브월, 곧 봄이었다. 이스라엘 자손이 이집트에서 나온 지 480년이 지난 때였다.

pt.L: E aconteceu no ano 480 depois da saída dos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, no quarto ano, no mês de Zive, que [é] o segundo mês, do reinado de Salomão sobre Israel, que ele construiu a casa para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: No ano 480 depois que os israelitas saíram da terra do Egito, no quarto ano do reinado de Salomão sobre Israel, no mês de Zive, que é o segundo mês, ele começou a construir a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Salomão começou a construir o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} no quarto ano do seu reinado sobre Israel. Foi no mês de Zive, o segundo mês do ano, entre abril e maio. Isso aconteceu 480 anos depois que os israelitas saíram do Egito.

decisions.choice: the 480th year after the exodus: a date that ties the temple to the coming out of Egypt
alternatives: twelve generations of forty years, a round figure
decisions.reason: The writer dates the founding of the temple from the exodus, so that the house of Yahweh is the goal of the journey that began in Egypt (Exodus 15:17; Deuteronomy 12:10-11). Taken as a plain count of years from Solomon's fourth year, it puts the exodus in the middle of the fifteenth century BC. Many readers of the evidence from Egypt and Canaan place it in the thirteenth century instead, and take 480 as twelve generations of forty years, a round figure for the whole period. The Hebrew gives the number without comment, and the question is not settled.

decisions.choice: four hundred and eightieth: the reading of the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The early Greek translation reads "440th" here. The Hebrew number is kept; the Greek may reflect a different count of the years in the books of Joshua and Judges.

decisions.choice: the month of Ziv: the second month, April-May
decisions.reason: Ziv is an old Canaanite month name, meaning "brightness" or "bloom". The writer explains it as the second month of the year counted from the spring (Exodus 12:2), about April-May. Later the Jewish calendar called it Iyyar. It is named again in verse 37.

decisions.choice: he built the house: he began the building
decisions.reason: The verse dates the start of the work, as verse 37 says ("the foundation was laid"); verse 38 dates its completion seven years later.

decisions.choice: began to build the house of the LORD (Balanced); began to build the temple of the LORD (Readable)
decisions.reason: Because the verse marks the start of seven years of work (verses 37-38), Balanced and Readable say "began to build". Balanced keeps "house of the LORD" for the full phrase, as in 3:1; Readable says "temple", as in 3:1.

decisions.choice: the second month of the year, in spring
decisions.reason: Readable adds the season so that the old month name means something to the reader.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list for Spanish: "hijos" and "israelitas" already take in women, so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: "comenzó a edificar la casa del SEÑOR" (B); "comenzó a construir el templo del SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Kings terms note: the house of the LORD is "la casa" at Literal and Balanced, "el templo" at Readable; the verb says he began the work.

decisions.choice: les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d'Israël (L); les {{gender:Israélites|fils d'Israël}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The gender spans of the French Pentateuch for "the sons of Israel", one wording per level.

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli (Literal); Waisraeli (Balanced, Readable), no gender span
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili Pentateuch: "wana wa Israeli" and "Waisraeli" already include men and women, so the English gender setting has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "시브월" for the month Ziv
decisions.reason: The month name in its usual Korean Bible form; Readable adds the season as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L); "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Samuel, "con cháu" and "dân" already include men and women, so the English gender setting has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: o mês de Zive; entre abril e maio (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the old month name (m3) takes a Brazilian form with a final -e, "Zive", as Exodus 13:4 in Portuguese writes "Abibe"; "Bul" (6:38) needs no change. The English Readable adds "in spring", but for readers in the southern hemisphere April-May is autumn, so Readable gives the months of our calendar instead, as Exodus 13:4 in Portuguese does.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender span
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Israel
decisions.reason: As in the Old Testament terms (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md): "filhos" and "israelitas" already take in women and men, so Portuguese has no second wording to offer where the English has a gender span. The year is written in figures, "480", a long number that is not round (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 5).

fr.B: Le temple que le roi Salomon bâtit pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait {{units:environ 27 mètres|soixante coudées}} de long, {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large et {{units:environ 13,50 mètres|trente coudées}} de haut.

sw.R: Hekalu ambalo mfalme Sulemani alimjengea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 27|dhiraa sitini}} na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}. Kimo chake kilikuwa {{units:karibu mita 13.5|dhiraa thelathini}}.

pt.B: O templo que o rei Salomão construiu para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha {{units:cerca de 27 metros|sessenta côvados}} de comprimento, {{units:cerca de 9 metros|vinte côvados}} de largura e {{units:cerca de 13,5 metros|trinta côvados}} de altura.

decisions.choice: cubit: about 18 inches
decisions.reason: A cubit was the length from the elbow to the tip of the middle finger, about 18 inches. A longer royal cubit was also used (2 Chronicles 3:3 speaks of "the former measure"), so the sizes in this chapter are approximate.

decisions.choice: the house: the main building, the hall and the inner room together
decisions.reason: The 60 cubits are the length of the main hall (40 cubits, verse 17) and the inner room (20 cubits, verse 20) together. The porch in front (verse 3) and the side rooms (verse 5) are counted separately.

decisions.choice: the temple
decisions.reason: The word is "house", and Literal keeps it. In this chapter it names the building as a whole, so Balanced and Readable say "temple", keeping "house of the LORD" for the full phrase (verses 1 and 37). It is kept apart from the words for the main hall (verse 3) and the inner room (verse 5).

decisions.choice: modern measures with the cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the size in feet, reckoning a cubit at about 18 inches; the reader's Measures control shows the cubits. Literal keeps the cubits throughout this chapter.

decisions.choice: metres, with the cubits as the alternative (B, R); "codos" (L)
decisions.reason: The cubit is counted at 45 cm, as the Kings terms note sets; Balanced and Readable give metres in a units span with the cubits as the alternative, as the English gives feet (r-en-2). Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: metric measures, with the cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the terms note asks, French gives metres by default, counting a cubit at 45 cm, with the cubits as the reader's alternative; the English default is in feet. Literal keeps the cubits throughout this chapter.

decisions.choice: le temple
decisions.reason: In this chapter Balanced and Readable say "le temple" for the building as a whole, as the English does, and keep "la maison du SEIGNEUR" at Balanced for the full phrase.

decisions.choice: hekalu
decisions.reason: Where "the house" names the whole building in this description, Balanced and Readable say "hekalu" (temple), as the English does; Literal keeps "nyumba", and "the house of the LORD" stays "nyumba ya BWANA" at Balanced.

decisions.choice: metres (karibu mita 27), with dhiraa as the alternative
decisions.reason: Swahili gives the metric value by default, reckoning a cubit at 45 cm, where the English converts to feet; Literal keeps "dhiraa" (cubits).

decisions.choice: "27 m" (default); "60 cu-đê" (alternative)
decisions.reason: As in the earlier Vietnamese books, metric by default (cubit 45 cm, as the terms notes set), not the English feet; Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: "đền thờ" (B, R) where the English says "the temple"
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the English here in naming the building "đền thờ"; Literal keeps "nhà".

decisions.choice: Metres by default (cubit 45 cm), "규빗" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note: Korean gives metric with 쯤, the cubits in the span; Literal keeps the cubits, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: "성전" where the English Balanced says "temple"; "집" at Literal
decisions.reason: In the building chapters the English Balanced and Readable say "temple"; Korean follows each level.

decisions.choice: metric by default, with the "côvados" as the alternative: {{units:cerca de 27 metros|sessenta côvados}}
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Portuguese gives the sizes in metric units where the English gives feet, reckoning a cubit at 45 centimetres (m1), with a decimal comma, as the Old Testament terms and Exodus 25-27 in Portuguese do; the reader's Measures control shows the "côvados". Literal keeps the cubits, with the numbers in words.

decisions.choice: a casa (L); o templo (B, R); a casa do SENHOR for the full phrase (L, B), o templo do SENHOR (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew word "casa"; Balanced and Readable call the building "o templo", and Balanced keeps "a casa do SENHOR" for the full phrase (verses 1 and 37), as 3:1 in Portuguese does. "Santuário" is kept for the inner room (verse 5).

source.text: וְהָאוּלָ֗ם עַל־פְּנֵי֙ הֵיכַ֣ל הַבַּ֔יִת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ עַל־פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֣חַב הַבָּ֑יִת עֶ֧שֶׂר בָּאַמָּ֛ה רָחְבּ֖וֹ עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the porch on [the] face of [the] hall of the house: twenty cubit[s] its length, on [the] face of [the] breadth of the house; ten by the cubit its breadth, on [the] face of the house.

en.L: And the porch in front of the hall of the house: 20 cubits [was] its length, along the breadth of the house; 10 cubits [was] its depth in front of the house.
en.B: The porch in front of the main hall of the temple was {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} long, matching the width of the temple, and it reached out {{units:about 15 feet|10 cubits}} from the front of the temple.
en.R: In front of the main room of the temple there was a porch. It ran {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} across the whole front of the temple, and it reached out {{units:about 15 feet|10 cubits}} from the building.

es.L: Y el pórtico delante de la nave de la casa: veinte codos [era] su longitud, a lo ancho de la casa; diez codos [era] su anchura delante de la casa.
es.B: El pórtico que estaba delante de la sala principal de la casa tenía {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de largo, igual que el ancho de la casa, y sobresalía {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} del frente de la casa.
es.R: Delante de la sala principal del templo había un pórtico. Medía {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} a lo largo de todo el frente del templo, y sobresalía {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} del edificio.

fr.L: Et le vestibule devant la grande salle de la maison : vingt coudées [était] sa longueur, sur la largeur de la maison ; dix coudées [était] sa profondeur devant la maison.
fr.B: Le vestibule devant la grande salle du temple avait {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de long, autant que la largeur du temple, et il avançait de {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}} sur le devant du temple.
fr.R: Devant la salle principale du temple, il y avait un vestibule. Il s’étendait sur {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}, sur toute la largeur de la façade du temple, et il avançait de {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}} devant le bâtiment.

sw.L: Na baraza mbele ya ukumbi wa nyumba: urefu wake [ulikuwa] dhiraa ishirini, kufuata upana wa nyumba; upana wake [ulikuwa] dhiraa kumi mbele ya nyumba.
sw.B: Baraza lililokuwa mbele ya ukumbi mkuu wa hekalu lilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}, sawa na upana wa hekalu, nalo lilitokeza {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}} mbele ya hekalu.
sw.R: Mbele ya chumba kikuu cha hekalu kulikuwa na baraza. Lilienea {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}} upande wote wa mbele wa hekalu, nalo lilitokeza {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}} kutoka kwenye jengo.

vi.L: Tiền sảnh trước gian chính của nhà: chiều dài 20 cu-đê, theo chiều rộng của nhà; chiều sâu 10 cu-đê, ở phía trước nhà.
vi.B: Tiền sảnh phía trước chính điện của đền thờ dài {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}, bằng chiều rộng đền thờ, và nhô ra phía trước đền thờ {{units:4,5 m|10 cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Phía trước gian chính của đền thờ có một tiền sảnh. Tiền sảnh dài {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}, chạy suốt mặt tiền đền thờ, và nhô ra khỏi tòa nhà {{units:4,5 m|10 cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그 집 본당 앞의 현관은 그 길이가 집의 너비를 따라 이십 규빗이었고, 그 깊이는 집 앞으로 십 규빗이었다.
ko.B: 성전 본당 앞에 있는 현관은 길이가 성전의 너비와 같은 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}이었고, 성전 앞쪽으로 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}} 나와 있었다.
ko.R: 성전의 큰 방 앞에는 현관이 있었다. 현관은 성전 앞면 전체에 걸쳐 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}이었고, 건물에서 앞으로 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}} 나와 있었다.

pt.L: E o pórtico diante do salão da casa: vinte côvados [era] o seu comprimento, ao longo da largura da casa; dez côvados [era] a sua profundidade diante da casa.
pt.B: O pórtico diante do salão principal do templo tinha {{units:cerca de 9 metros|vinte côvados}} de comprimento, a mesma largura do templo, e avançava {{units:cerca de 4,50 metros|dez côvados}} a partir da frente do templo.
pt.R: Na frente da sala principal do templo havia um pórtico. Ele ocupava toda a frente do templo, com {{units:cerca de 9 metros|vinte côvados}}, e avançava {{units:cerca de 4,50 metros|dez côvados}} para fora do prédio.

decisions.choice: the porch: the entrance hall at the front of the temple
decisions.reason: The word names the front part of the building, through which one entered (7:6-7, 12, 19, 21). It may have been an open porch or a roofed entrance room; its height is not given here. It stood at the east end, since the temple faced east (Ezekiel 8:16).

decisions.choice: the hall: the main room of the temple
decisions.reason: The word can mean a palace or a temple as a whole (Psalm 45:16; 1 Samuel 1:9). Here it names the large front room of the building, 40 cubits long (verse 17), where the priests served, as set against the inner room behind it (verse 5).

decisions.choice: length ... breadth: across the front, and outward from it
decisions.reason: The porch's "length" of 20 cubits runs along the width of the temple; its "breadth" of 10 cubits is how far it stands out from the front.

decisions.choice: porch (all levels); hall (Literal), main hall (Balanced), main room (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Porch" is a plain word for the entrance hall. "Hall" keeps the larger room apart from "temple", which Balanced and Readable use for the whole house; Balanced and Readable add "main" so that it is clear which room is meant.

decisions.choice: "el pórtico" (all levels); "la nave" (L), "la sala principal" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The temple's main room is "la nave" at Literal, the architectural word for a long hall, and "la sala principal" at Balanced and Readable, as the English says "hall", "main hall", "main room" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: le vestibule; la grande salle (L, B), la salle principale (R)
decisions.reason: "Vestibule" is the plain word for the entrance hall; the main room is "la grande salle", "la salle principale" at Readable, keeping it apart from "temple", which names the whole house.

decisions.choice: baraza (porch); ukumbi (Literal), ukumbi mkuu (Balanced), chumba kikuu (Readable)
decisions.reason: The entrance hall is "baraza" at every level; the main room (*heikal*) is "ukumbi", "ukumbi mkuu" or "chumba kikuu", following the English levels; used through chapters 6-7.

decisions.choice: "tiền sảnh" for the porch; "gian chính" (L, R), "chính điện" (B) for the hall
decisions.reason: The entrance hall and the main room of the temple (meaning decisions); plain building words, kept for these rooms through chapters 6-8.

decisions.choice: "현관" for the porch; "본당" (L, B), "큰 방" (R) for the hall
decisions.reason: Plain modern words for the parts of the building; the older terms are kept out so the Readable reader can follow the plan.

decisions.choice: o pórtico (every level); o salão (L), o salão principal (B), a sala principal (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "pórtico" is the entrance at the front of a building, open or roofed (m1), a word Brazilian readers know from churches and public buildings; "vestíbulo" is an inside entry room and "varanda" a house porch. The large front room (m2) is "o salão" at Literal, with "principal" at Balanced and "a sala principal" at Readable, as the English adds "main"; "o Lugar Santo", the Law's name for the tabernacle's outer room, is not used because this chapter does not use it.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לַבָּ֔יִת חַלּוֹנֵ֖י שְׁקֻפִ֥ים אֲטֻמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made for the house windows of frames, closed.

en.L: And he made for the house windows of recessed frames.
en.B: He made windows for the temple with recessed frames.
en.R: He made windows for the temple that were set deep in their frames.

es.L: E hizo para la casa ventanas de marcos empotrados.
es.B: Hizo para la casa ventanas con marcos empotrados.
es.R: Hizo para el templo ventanas que estaban metidas hondo en sus marcos.

fr.L: Et il fit pour la maison des fenêtres à cadres en retrait.
fr.B: Il fit pour le temple des fenêtres à cadres en retrait.
fr.R: Il a fait pour le temple des fenêtres qui étaient enfoncées dans leur cadre.

sw.L: Akaifanyia nyumba madirisha ya fremu zilizoingia ndani.
sw.B: Akalifanyia hekalu madirisha yenye fremu zilizoingia ndani.
sw.R: Akalifanyia hekalu madirisha yaliyowekwa ndani kabisa ya fremu zake.

vi.L: Vua làm cho nhà những cửa sổ có khung lõm vào.
vi.B: Vua làm cho đền thờ các cửa sổ có khung lõm vào.
vi.R: Vua làm cho đền thờ những cửa sổ nằm sâu trong khung.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그 집에 틀이 붙박인 창문들을 만들었다.
ko.B: 그는 성전에 틀을 깊이 들인 창문들을 냈다.
ko.R: 그는 성전에 창문을 냈는데, 창문은 틀 안에 깊숙이 들어가 있었다.

pt.L: E fez para a casa janelas de molduras embutidas.
pt.B: Fez para o templo janelas com molduras embutidas.
pt.R: Ele fez para o templo janelas bem fundas, encaixadas em molduras.

decisions.choice: windows with recessed frames
alternatives: windows narrow outside and wide inside
decisions.reason: The two words after "windows" are rare. The first seems to mean a frame or an opening framed with beams (7:4-5). The second means "closed" or "narrowed" (Ezekiel 40:16; 41:16, 26). They may describe windows set in frames that narrow as they go into the wall, windows closed with a lattice, or windows with fixed frames that could not be opened. They would have been high in the walls, above the side rooms (verses 5-6).

source.text: וַיִּבֶן֩ עַל־קִ֨יר הַבַּ֤יִת יָצִ֨יעַ֙ סָבִ֔יב אֶת־קִיר֤וֹת הַבַּ֨יִת֙ סָבִ֔יב לַֽהֵיכָ֖ל וְלַדְּבִ֑יר וַיַּ֥עַשׂ צְלָע֖וֹת סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he built against [the] wall of the house a side structure all around, [against] the walls of the house all around, for the hall and for the inner room; and he made side rooms all around.

en.L: And he built against the wall of the house a side structure all around, [against] the walls of the house all around, both the hall and the inner room; and he made side chambers all around.
en.B: Against the wall of the temple he built a side structure that ran all around it, along the walls of both the main hall and the inner sanctuary, and he made side rooms all around.
en.R: Solomon built a building with rooms in it against the outside walls of the temple. It went all around the main room and the inner room.

es.L: Y edificó junto al muro de la casa una estructura lateral alrededor, [junto a] los muros de la casa alrededor, de la nave y del cuarto interior; e hizo cámaras laterales alrededor.
es.B: Junto al muro de la casa edificó una estructura lateral que la rodeaba, a lo largo de los muros de la sala principal y del santuario interior, e hizo cuartos laterales alrededor.
es.R: Salomón construyó un edificio con cuartos junto a los muros exteriores del templo. Rodeaba la sala principal y el lugar santísimo.

fr.L: Et il bâtit contre le mur de la maison une annexe tout autour, [contre] les murs de la maison tout autour, de la grande salle et du lieu très saint ; et il fit des chambres latérales tout autour.
fr.B: Contre le mur du temple, il bâtit une annexe qui en faisait le tour, le long des murs de la grande salle et du lieu très saint, et il fit des chambres latérales tout autour.
fr.R: Contre les murs extérieurs du temple, Salomon a construit un bâtiment avec des chambres. Il faisait tout le tour de la salle principale et du lieu très saint.

sw.L: Akajenga kuegemea ukuta wa nyumba jengo la pembeni kuzunguka pande zote, [kuegemea] kuta za nyumba pande zote, za ukumbi na za chumba cha ndani; akafanya vyumba vya pembeni pande zote.
sw.B: Kuegemea ukuta wa hekalu alijenga jengo la pembeni lililolizunguka pande zote, kando ya kuta za ukumbi mkuu na za Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, akafanya vyumba vya pembeni pande zote.
sw.R: Sulemani alijenga jengo lenye vyumba kuegemea kuta za nje za hekalu. Lilizunguka chumba kikuu na Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.

vi.L: Vua xây sát tường nhà một dãy nhà phụ chung quanh, [sát] các tường nhà chung quanh, cả gian chính lẫn phòng trong; vua làm các phòng phụ chung quanh.
vi.B: Sát tường đền thờ, vua xây một dãy nhà phụ bao quanh, dọc theo tường của cả chính điện lẫn phòng trong, và làm các phòng phụ chung quanh.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn xây một dãy nhà có nhiều phòng sát tường ngoài của đền thờ. Dãy nhà ấy bao quanh gian chính và phòng trong.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그 집의 벽에 붙여 사방으로 곁채를 지었는데, 본당과 내실의 [둘레], 곧 집의 벽들 사방에 [지었다]. 그리고 그는 사방에 곁방들을 만들었다.
ko.B: 그는 성전 벽에 붙여 본당과 지성소를 빙 둘러 곁채를 지었고, 그 둘레에 곁방들을 만들었다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 성전 바깥벽에 붙여서 방이 여러 개 있는 건물을 지었다. 그 건물은 큰 방과 지성소를 빙 둘러 있었다.

pt.L: E construiu junto à parede da casa uma estrutura lateral ao redor, [junto] às paredes da casa ao redor, tanto do salão como do santuário interior; e fez câmaras laterais ao redor.
pt.B: Junto à parede do templo, ele construiu uma estrutura lateral que o rodeava, ao longo das paredes tanto do salão principal como do santuário interior, e fez salas laterais em toda a volta.
pt.R: Salomão construiu um prédio com salas, encostado nas paredes de fora do templo. Ele dava a volta na sala principal e na sala interior.

decisions.choice: side structure: the annex built around the temple
decisions.reason: The written text and the form the scribes marked to be read aloud spell this word differently (here and in verses 6 and 10), but both name the same thing: a structure built against the outer walls, holding the side rooms. Both are rare words found only in this chapter.

decisions.choice: the inner room: the most holy place at the back of the temple
alternatives: the oracle, the place of speaking
decisions.reason: The word names the innermost room of the house, where the ark was placed (verses 16, 19-20; 8:6). It may come from a word for "back" or "rear"; an older explanation linked it with "speak", as the place of God's word, but this is less likely. Verse 16 calls it "the most holy place".

decisions.choice: side rooms: storerooms in stories along the walls
decisions.reason: The word means "side" or "rib" (Genesis 2:21). Here it names rooms built in three stories (verses 6, 8, 10), probably used to store temple goods and gifts (7:51).

decisions.choice: side structure; inner room (Literal), inner sanctuary (Balanced), inner room (Readable); side chambers (Literal), side rooms (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal and Readable call the innermost room the "inner room", which says plainly where it was. Balanced says "inner sanctuary" so that it is clear it is the holiest place, not a storeroom.

decisions.choice: a building with rooms in it
decisions.reason: Readable puts the side structure and its rooms together in one plain description.

decisions.choice: "el cuarto interior" (L); "el santuario interior" (B); "el lugar santísimo" (R)
decisions.reason: The devir follows the Kings terms note for Spanish, one wording per level through the temple chapters. The English Readable says "inner room"; Spanish Readable names it "el lugar santísimo", as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: le lieu très saint
decisions.reason: The terms note settles "le lieu très saint" for the inner room (*devir*) at every level, so that it is never taken for a storeroom; the English varies "inner room" and "inner sanctuary".

decisions.choice: chumba cha ndani (Literal); Patakatifu pa Patakatifu (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The *devir* is "Patakatifu pa Patakatifu", the name the terms note settles for Swahili and the one the Pentateuch uses for the most holy place; Literal keeps the Hebrew "chumba cha ndani" (inner room).

decisions.choice: "phòng trong" for the *devir*; "Nơi Chí Thánh" for the holy of holies
decisions.reason: The Kings terms note gives "Nơi Chí Thánh" for the most holy place; where the English names the *devir* as "the inner room" or "inner sanctuary", Vietnamese says "phòng trong", and "Nơi Chí Thánh" where the text names it most holy, so the two stay distinguishable as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "내실" (L); "지성소" (B, R) for the *devir*
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note, Korean names the inner room 지성소 at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps "inner room".

decisions.choice: o santuário interior (L, B); a sala interior (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the innermost room (m2) is "o santuário interior" at Literal and Balanced, which says both where it was and that it was the holy place; at Literal "a sala interior", word for word as the English "inner room", could be taken for any back room or storeroom, the confusion the English Balanced avoids with "inner sanctuary". Readable says "a sala interior", set against "a sala principal" as the English Readable does, and says in verse 16 that it is the Lugar Santíssimo. "Oráculo", the old rendering from the Latin, rests on the less likely link with "speak" (m2).

decisions.choice: uma estrutura lateral (L, B); câmaras laterais (L), salas laterais (B)
decisions.reason: As the English: "estrutura lateral" for the annex built against the walls (m1), and "câmaras" (L) or "salas" (B) for the side rooms (m3); "quarto" would suggest a bedroom.

source.text: הַיָּצִ֨יעַ הַתַּחְתֹּנָ֜ה חָמֵ֧שׁ בָּאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבָּ֗הּ וְהַתִּֽיכֹנָה֙ שֵׁ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וְהַ֨שְּׁלִישִׁ֔ית שֶׁ֥בַע בָּאַמָּ֖ה רָחְבָּ֑הּ כִּ֡י מִגְרָעוֹת֩ נָתַ֨ן לַבַּ֤יִת סָבִיב֙ ח֔וּצָה לְבִלְתִּ֖י אֲחֹ֥ז בְּקִֽירוֹת־הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: The side structure the lowest: five by the cubit its breadth; and the middle: six by the cubit its breadth; and the third: seven by the cubit its breadth; for ledges he made for the house all around outside, so as not to grasp into [the] walls of the house.

en.L: The lowest [story of the] side structure, 5 cubits [was] its breadth, and the middle six cubits its breadth, and the third seven cubits its breadth; for he made ledges for the house all around outside, so that [the beams] would not grasp into the walls of the house.
en.B: The lowest story was {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} wide, the middle one {{units:about 9 feet|6 cubits}} wide, and the third {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|7 cubits}} wide. He had made ledges around the outside of the temple wall, so that the beams would not be set into the walls of the temple.
en.R: The rooms on the ground floor were {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} wide. The rooms on the middle floor were {{units:about 9 feet|6 cubits}} wide, and the rooms on the top floor were {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|7 cubits}} wide. This was because the temple wall became thinner at each floor, leaving a ledge all around the outside. The beams of the side building rested on these ledges, so they did not have to be cut into the temple walls.

es.L: La estructura lateral, la más baja, tenía cinco codos de anchura, y la del medio seis codos de anchura, y la tercera siete codos de anchura; porque hizo rebajos en la casa alrededor por fuera, para no empotrar [las vigas] en los muros de la casa.
es.B: El piso más bajo tenía {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de ancho, el del medio {{units:unos 2,70 metros|seis codos}} y el tercero {{units:unos 3,15 metros|siete codos}}. Había hecho rebajos alrededor del muro de la casa por fuera, para que las vigas no se empotraran en los muros de la casa.
es.R: Los cuartos de la planta baja tenían {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de ancho. Los del piso del medio tenían {{units:unos 2,70 metros|seis codos}}, y los del piso de arriba {{units:unos 3,15 metros|siete codos}}. Esto era porque el muro del templo se hacía más delgado en cada piso y dejaba un borde por todo el exterior. Las vigas del edificio lateral descansaban sobre esos bordes, y así no tenían que meterse en los muros del templo.

fr.L: L’étage inférieur [de l’annexe], cinq coudées [était] sa largeur, et celui du milieu six coudées sa largeur, et le troisième sept coudées sa largeur ; car il avait fait des retraits à la maison tout autour à l’extérieur, afin que [les poutres] ne s’enfoncent pas dans les murs de la maison.
fr.B: L’étage inférieur avait {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de large, celui du milieu {{units:environ 2,70 mètres|six coudées}}, et le troisième {{units:environ 3,15 mètres|sept coudées}}. Il avait en effet ménagé des retraits tout autour du mur extérieur du temple, afin que les poutres ne soient pas encastrées dans les murs du temple.
fr.R: Les chambres du rez-de-chaussée avaient {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de large. Celles de l’étage du milieu avaient {{units:environ 2,70 mètres|six coudées}} de large, et celles de l’étage du haut {{units:environ 3,15 mètres|sept coudées}}. C’est parce que le mur du temple devenait plus mince à chaque étage, ce qui laissait un rebord tout autour à l’extérieur. Les poutres de l’annexe reposaient sur ces rebords, et il n’avait donc pas fallu les encastrer dans les murs du temple.

sw.L: Jengo la pembeni la chini kabisa, upana wake [ulikuwa] dhiraa tano, na la katikati upana wake dhiraa sita, na la tatu upana wake dhiraa saba; kwa maana aliifanyia nyumba vipandio pande zote nje, ili [boriti] zisishike ndani ya kuta za nyumba.
sw.B: Ghorofa ya chini ilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, ya katikati {{units:karibu mita 2.7|dhiraa sita}}, na ya tatu {{units:karibu mita 3.15|dhiraa saba}}. Alikuwa amefanya vipandio kuzunguka nje ya ukuta wa hekalu, ili boriti zisitiwe ndani ya kuta za hekalu.
sw.R: Vyumba vya ghorofa ya chini vilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}. Vyumba vya ghorofa ya katikati vilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 2.7|dhiraa sita}}, na vya ghorofa ya juu {{units:karibu mita 3.15|dhiraa saba}}. Hii ilikuwa kwa sababu ukuta wa hekalu ulipungua unene kila ghorofa, ukaacha kipandio kuzunguka nje. Boriti za jengo la pembeni zililala juu ya vipandio hivyo, hivyo hazikuhitaji kukatiwa ndani ya kuta za hekalu.

vi.L: Tầng dưới cùng [của] dãy nhà phụ rộng 5 cu-đê, tầng giữa rộng 6 cu-đê, và tầng thứ ba rộng 7 cu-đê; vì vua làm những gờ chung quanh bên ngoài nhà, để [các đà] không phải gác vào tường nhà.
vi.B: Tầng dưới cùng rộng {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}, tầng giữa rộng {{units:2,7 m|6 cu-đê}}, và tầng thứ ba rộng {{units:3,15 m|7 cu-đê}}. Vua đã làm những gờ chung quanh mặt ngoài tường đền thờ, để các đà không phải gác vào tường đền thờ.
vi.R: Các phòng ở tầng trệt rộng {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}. Các phòng ở tầng giữa rộng {{units:2,7 m|6 cu-đê}}, và các phòng ở tầng trên cùng rộng {{units:3,15 m|7 cu-đê}}. Đó là vì tường đền thờ mỏng dần lên mỗi tầng, chừa ra một cái gờ chạy chung quanh bên ngoài. Các đà của dãy nhà phụ gác lên những gờ ấy, nên không cần đục vào tường đền thờ.

ko.L: 곁채의 아래층은 그 너비가 다섯 규빗, 중간층은 그 너비가 여섯 규빗, 셋째 층은 그 너비가 일곱 규빗이었다. 그가 집 바깥 사방에 턱을 만들어 [들보가] 집의 벽 속에 박히지 않게 했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 아래층은 너비가 {{units:약 2.25미터|다섯 규빗}}, 중간층은 {{units:약 2.7미터|여섯 규빗}}, 셋째 층은 {{units:약 3.15미터|일곱 규빗}}이었다. 성전 바깥벽 둘레에 턱을 만들어 들보가 성전 벽 속에 박히지 않게 했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 1층 방들은 너비가 {{units:약 2.25미터|다섯 규빗}}, 2층 방들은 {{units:약 2.7미터|여섯 규빗}}, 3층 방들은 {{units:약 3.15미터|일곱 규빗}}이었다. 성전 벽이 위층으로 갈수록 얇아져서 바깥 둘레에 턱이 생겼기 때문이다. 곁채의 들보는 이 턱 위에 놓여서 성전 벽을 파고 들어갈 필요가 없었다.

pt.L: O [andar] mais baixo da estrutura lateral, cinco côvados [era] a sua largura; e o do meio, seis côvados a sua largura; e o terceiro, sete côvados a sua largura; porque ele fez saliências para a casa ao redor, por fora, para que [as vigas] não se prendessem nas paredes da casa.
pt.B: O andar de baixo tinha {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de largura, o do meio, {{units:cerca de 2,70 metros|seis côvados}}, e o terceiro, {{units:cerca de 3,15 metros|sete côvados}}. Ele tinha feito saliências em volta da parede do templo, pelo lado de fora, para que as vigas não fossem encaixadas nas paredes do templo.
pt.R: As salas do térreo tinham {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de largura. As do andar do meio tinham {{units:cerca de 2,70 metros|seis côvados}}, e as do último andar, {{units:cerca de 3,15 metros|sete côvados}}. É que a parede do templo ficava mais fina a cada andar, formando um degrau em toda a volta, pelo lado de fora. As vigas do prédio lateral se apoiavam nesses degraus e por isso não precisavam ser encaixadas nas paredes do templo.

decisions.choice: the side structure: as in verse 5
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, the written text and the form read aloud spell the word differently. The feminine words that follow ("lowest", "middle", "third") speak of its stories.

decisions.choice: ledges: the temple wall stepped in at each story, and the beams of the side rooms rested on the steps
decisions.reason: The temple wall was thickest at the bottom and stepped back one cubit at each story. The floor beams of the side rooms rested on these ledges instead of being set into holes in the temple wall. That is why each story is one cubit wider than the one below.

decisions.choice: [the beams] (Literal); the beams (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say what would not be fastened into the walls; from the building method it is the beams of the side rooms.

decisions.choice: the temple wall became thinner at each floor
decisions.reason: Readable explains how the ledges made each floor wider than the one below, which the Hebrew leaves the reader to work out.

decisions.choice: saliências (L, B); um degrau (R)
decisions.reason: The ledges are steps in the wall on which the beams rested (m2). "Saliência" is the plain word for a part that juts out; Readable says "degrau", which pictures the wall stepping in at each floor.

source.text: וְהַבַּ֨יִת֙ בְּהִבָּ֣נֹת֔וֹ אֶֽבֶן־שְׁלֵמָ֥ה מַסָּ֖ע נִבְנָ֑ה וּמַקָּב֤וֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן֙ כָּל־כְּלִ֣י בַרְזֶ֔ל לֹֽא־נִשְׁמַ֥ע בַּבַּ֖יִת בְּהִבָּנֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the house, in its being built, [of] stone finished [at the] quarry it was built; and hammers and the axe, any tool of iron, not was heard in the house in its being built.

en.L: And the house, when it was built, was built [of] stone finished at the quarry; and hammers and axe, any tool of iron, was not heard in the house when it was built.
en.B: The temple was built of stone that had been dressed at the quarry, so the sound of hammer, axe or any iron tool was never heard at the temple during the building.
en.R: The stones used to build the temple were cut and shaped at the place where they were dug out. So while the temple was being built, no one heard the sound of a hammer, an axe, or any other iron tool there.

es.L: Y la casa, cuando se edificó, se edificó [con] piedra acabada en la cantera; y ni martillos ni hacha, ni ninguna herramienta de hierro se oyó en la casa cuando se edificaba.
es.B: La casa se edificó con piedra ya labrada en la cantera, de modo que durante la construcción nunca se oyó en la casa ruido de martillo, de hacha ni de ninguna herramienta de hierro.
es.R: Las piedras que se usaron para construir el templo se cortaron y labraron en el lugar de donde se sacaban. Así que, mientras se construía el templo, nadie oyó allí el ruido de un martillo, de un hacha ni de ninguna otra herramienta de hierro.

fr.L: Et la maison, quand elle fut bâtie, fut bâtie de pierre achevée à la carrière ; et marteaux et hache, aucun outil de fer, ne fut entendu dans la maison quand elle fut bâtie.
fr.B: Le temple fut construit avec des pierres déjà taillées à la carrière, si bien qu’on n’entendit jamais dans le temple, pendant sa construction, le bruit du marteau, de la hache ou d’aucun outil de fer.
fr.R: Les pierres qui ont servi à construire le temple ont été taillées et préparées à l’endroit où on les avait extraites. Ainsi, pendant la construction du temple, personne n’a entendu là le bruit d’un marteau, d’une hache ou d’un autre outil de fer.

sw.L: Na nyumba, ilipokuwa ikijengwa, ilijengwa [kwa] mawe yaliyokamilishwa machimboni; wala nyundo wala shoka, wala chombo chochote cha chuma, hakikusikika nyumbani ilipokuwa ikijengwa.
sw.B: Hekalu lilijengwa kwa mawe yaliyochongwa huko machimboni, hivyo sauti ya nyundo, shoka au chombo chochote cha chuma haikusikika kamwe hekaluni wakati wa ujenzi.
sw.R: Mawe yaliyotumika kujenga hekalu yalikatwa na kuchongwa mahali yalipochimbuliwa. Hivyo hekalu lilipokuwa likijengwa, hakuna mtu aliyesikia huko sauti ya nyundo, shoka wala chombo kingine chochote cha chuma.

vi.L: Khi xây nhà, người ta xây [bằng] đá đã đẽo xong tại mỏ đá; búa, rìu, hay bất cứ dụng cụ bằng sắt nào, đều không nghe thấy trong nhà khi đang xây.
vi.B: Đền thờ được xây bằng đá đã đẽo sẵn tại mỏ đá, nên trong suốt thời gian xây cất, không hề nghe tiếng búa, rìu hay bất cứ dụng cụ bằng sắt nào tại đền thờ.
vi.R: Đá dùng để xây đền thờ đã được cắt và đẽo sẵn tại nơi khai thác. Vì vậy, trong khi xây đền thờ, không ai nghe tiếng búa, rìu hay bất cứ dụng cụ bằng sắt nào ở đó.

ko.L: 그리고 그 집은 지을 때에 채석장에서 다 다듬은 돌로 지었다. 그래서 집을 지을 때에 망치나 도끼나 어떤 쇠 연장 소리도 집에서 들리지 않았다.
ko.B: 성전은 채석장에서 미리 다듬은 돌로 지었다. 그래서 성전을 짓는 동안 그곳에서는 망치나 도끼나 그 밖의 어떤 쇠 연장 소리도 들리지 않았다.
ko.R: 성전을 지을 돌은 돌을 캐낸 곳에서 미리 자르고 다듬었다. 그래서 성전을 짓는 동안 그곳에서는 망치 소리도, 도끼 소리도, 다른 쇠 연장 소리도 전혀 들리지 않았다.

pt.L: E a casa, quando foi construída, foi construída [com] pedra acabada na pedreira; e martelos e machado, qualquer ferramenta de ferro, não se ouviu na casa quando foi construída.
pt.B: O templo foi construído com pedras já lavradas na pedreira, e por isso não se ouviu no templo barulho de martelo, de machado nem de nenhuma ferramenta de ferro durante a construção.
pt.R: As pedras usadas na construção do templo eram cortadas e preparadas no lugar de onde eram tiradas. Por isso, enquanto o templo era construído, ninguém ouviu ali o barulho de martelo, de machado ou de qualquer outra ferramenta de ferro.

decisions.choice: stone finished at the quarry: blocks cut to shape before they were brought
decisions.reason: The phrase is short: "whole stone, quarry". It means stone dressed to its final shape where it was quarried (5:31-32), so that it only had to be set in place.

decisions.choice: no iron tool heard: the temple built in quietness
decisions.reason: The law said an altar must be of uncut stones on which no iron tool had been used (Exodus 20:25; Deuteronomy 27:5). Here the stones are cut, but away from the site, so the holy place was built without the noise of tools. The text does not say why; the silence fits the holiness of the house.

decisions.choice: so no hammer ... was heard
decisions.reason: Balanced joins the two clauses with "so", since the second follows from the first.

source.text: פֶּ֗תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה אֶל־כֶּ֥תֶף הַבַּ֖יִת הַיְמָנִ֑ית וּבְלוּלִּ֗ים יַֽעֲלוּ֙ עַל־הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה וּמִן־הַתִּֽיכֹנָ֖ה אֶל־הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] entrance of the side room the middle [was] at [the] side of the house the right; and by stairways they would go up to the middle, and from the middle to the third.

en.L: The entrance of the middle side chamber [was] on the right side of the house; and by stairways they went up to the middle [story], and from the middle to the third.
en.B: The entrance to the middle story of side rooms was on the south side of the temple, and stairways led up to the middle story and from the middle to the third.
en.R: The way into the side rooms was on the south side of the temple. From there, stairs led up to the middle floor, and from the middle floor to the top floor.

es.L: La entrada de la cámara lateral del medio [estaba] al lado derecho de la casa; y por escaleras de caracol subían al [piso] del medio, y del medio al tercero.
es.B: La entrada a los cuartos laterales del piso del medio estaba en el lado sur de la casa, y por unas escaleras se subía al piso del medio y del medio al tercero.
es.R: La entrada a los cuartos laterales estaba en el lado sur del templo. Desde allí unas escaleras subían al piso del medio, y del piso del medio al piso de arriba.

fr.L: L’entrée de la chambre latérale du milieu [était] du côté droit de la maison ; et par des escaliers on montait à celle du milieu, et de celle du milieu à la troisième.
fr.B: L’entrée de l’étage du milieu des chambres latérales se trouvait du côté sud du temple, et des escaliers menaient à l’étage du milieu, et de celui du milieu au troisième.
fr.R: On entrait dans les chambres latérales par le côté sud du temple. De là, des escaliers montaient à l’étage du milieu, et de l’étage du milieu à l’étage du haut.

sw.L: Mlango wa chumba cha pembeni cha katikati [ulikuwa] upande wa kuume wa nyumba; na kwa ngazi za kuzunguka walipanda mpaka [ghorofa ya] katikati, na kutoka katikati mpaka ya tatu.
sw.B: Mlango wa ghorofa ya katikati ya vyumba vya pembeni ulikuwa upande wa kusini wa hekalu, na ngazi zilipanda mpaka ghorofa ya katikati, na kutoka ya katikati mpaka ya tatu.
sw.R: Njia ya kuingia katika vyumba vya pembeni ilikuwa upande wa kusini wa hekalu. Kutoka hapo ngazi zilipanda mpaka ghorofa ya katikati, na kutoka ghorofa ya katikati mpaka ghorofa ya juu.

vi.L: Lối vào phòng phụ ở giữa [nằm] ở phía bên phải của nhà; người ta đi lên tầng giữa bằng cầu thang, và từ tầng giữa lên tầng thứ ba.
vi.B: Lối vào tầng giữa của các phòng phụ nằm ở phía nam đền thờ; có cầu thang dẫn lên tầng giữa, và từ tầng giữa lên tầng thứ ba.
vi.R: Lối vào các phòng phụ ở phía nam đền thờ. Từ đó có cầu thang đi lên tầng giữa, và từ tầng giữa lên tầng trên cùng.

ko.L: 가운데 곁방의 입구는 집의 오른쪽에 [있었고], 사람들은 나선 계단으로 가운데 [층]으로 올라가고, 가운데 층에서 셋째 층으로 올라갔다.
ko.B: 중간층 곁방으로 들어가는 입구는 성전의 남쪽에 있었고, 계단을 따라 중간층으로, 중간층에서 셋째 층으로 올라가게 되어 있었다.
ko.R: 곁방으로 들어가는 입구는 성전의 남쪽에 있었다. 거기서부터 계단을 따라 2층으로 올라가고, 2층에서 3층으로 올라갈 수 있었다.

pt.L: A entrada da câmara lateral do meio [ficava] no lado direito da casa; e por escadas subiam ao [andar] do meio, e do meio ao terceiro.
pt.B: A entrada para o andar do meio das salas laterais ficava no lado sul do templo, e escadas subiam até o andar do meio e do meio até o terceiro.
pt.R: A entrada das salas laterais ficava no lado sul do templo. Dali, escadas subiam até o andar do meio, e do andar do meio até o último andar.

decisions.choice: the entrance of the middle side room: the Hebrew text
alternatives: the entrance of the lowest story
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the entrance was to the "middle" side room. The early Greek translation reads "lowest", which fits the stairways that lead up from it to the middle story. The Hebrew may mean the entrance in the middle of the side structure's south wall. The Hebrew is kept.

decisions.choice: the right side: the south side
decisions.reason: Facing east, the direction the temple faced, the right hand is the south (7:39).

decisions.choice: stairways: probably winding stairs
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here. It may mean winding stairs, ladders, or shafts with trapdoors between the floors. Whatever its exact form, it was a way up from story to story.

decisions.choice: the south side
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "right"; Balanced and Readable give the direction it means.

decisions.choice: the way into the side rooms
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the entrance without the question about which story it opened onto, which the footnote on the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "el lado sur" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): facing east, the right side is the south; Literal keeps "derecho".

source.text: וַיִּ֥בֶן אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת וַיְכַלֵּ֑הוּ וַיִּסְפֹּ֤ן אֶת־הַבַּ֨יִת֙ גֵּבִ֔ים וּשְׂדֵרֹ֖ת בָּאֲרָזִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he built the house and finished it, and he covered the house [with] beams and rows of cedars.

en.L: And he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house [with] beams and rows of cedar.
en.B: So he built the temple and finished it, and he roofed it with beams and planks of cedar.
en.R: So Solomon built the temple and finished it. He made its roof out of cedar beams and boards.

es.L: Y edificó la casa y la terminó; y cubrió la casa [con] vigas y tablas de cedro.
es.B: Así edificó la casa y la terminó, y le puso un techo de vigas y tablas de cedro.
es.R: Así Salomón construyó el templo y lo terminó. Le hizo un techo de vigas y tablas de cedro.

fr.L: Et il bâtit la maison et l’acheva ; et il couvrit la maison [de] poutres et de rangées de cèdre.
fr.B: Il bâtit donc le temple et l’acheva, et il lui fit un toit de poutres et de planches de cèdre.
fr.R: Salomon a donc construit le temple et il l’a terminé. Il a fait le toit avec des poutres et des planches de cèdre.

sw.L: Akaijenga nyumba, akaimaliza; akaifunika nyumba [kwa] boriti na safu za mierezi.
sw.B: Basi akalijenga hekalu na kulimaliza, akaliezeka kwa boriti na mbao za mierezi.
sw.R: Basi Sulemani akalijenga hekalu na kulimaliza. Akatengeneza paa lake kwa boriti na mbao za mierezi.

vi.L: Vua xây nhà và hoàn tất; vua lợp nhà [bằng] đà và ván bá hương.
vi.B: Vậy vua xây xong đền thờ, và lợp mái bằng đà và ván gỗ bá hương.
vi.R: Vậy Sa-lô-môn xây xong đền thờ. Vua làm mái bằng đà và ván gỗ bá hương.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그 집을 지어 끝냈다. 그리고 그는 백향목 들보와 널판 줄로 집을 덮었다.
ko.B: 이렇게 그는 성전을 지어 완성했다. 그리고 백향목 들보와 널판으로 지붕을 덮었다.
ko.R: 이렇게 솔로몬은 성전을 다 지었다. 그는 백향목 들보와 널빤지로 지붕을 만들었다.

pt.L: E construiu a casa e a terminou; e cobriu a casa [com] vigas e fileiras de cedro.
pt.B: Assim ele construiu o templo e o terminou, e fez o teto com vigas e tábuas de cedro.
pt.R: Assim Salomão construiu o templo e terminou a obra. Ele fez o teto com vigas e tábuas de cedro.

decisions.choice: covered the house with beams and rows of cedar: roofed it
decisions.reason: The verb means to cover over, and is used of a roof or a ceiling (7:3, 7). The second noun means "rows" or "ranks" and may name planks laid in rows over the beams. It probably describes the roof, though it could mean a paneled ceiling inside.

decisions.choice: built ... and finished it: a summary of the outer building
decisions.reason: Verses 9 and 14 sum up the building of the outside; the chapter then turns to the inside and its decoration (verses 15-36). The work was finished only in the eleventh year (verse 38).

source.text: וַיִּ֤בֶן אֶת־הַיָּצִ֨יעַ֙ עַל־כָּל־הַבַּ֔יִת חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֽוֹמָת֑וֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹ֥ז אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת בַּעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he built the side structure against all the house, five cubits its height, and it held the house with timbers of cedars.

en.L: And he built the side structure against all the house, 5 cubits its height, and it was fastened to the house with timbers of cedar.
en.B: He built the side structure against the whole temple, each story {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} high, and joined it to the temple with cedar beams.
en.R: He built the side rooms all along the temple. Each floor was {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} high. Cedar beams joined this building to the temple.

es.L: Y edificó la estructura lateral junto a toda la casa, de cinco codos de altura, y estaba unida a la casa con maderas de cedro.
es.B: Edificó la estructura lateral a lo largo de toda la casa, con pisos de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto, y la unió a la casa con vigas de cedro.
es.R: Construyó los cuartos laterales a lo largo de todo el templo. Cada piso tenía {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto. Unas vigas de cedro unían este edificio al templo.

fr.L: Et il bâtit l’annexe contre toute la maison, cinq coudées sa hauteur, et elle tenait à la maison par des bois de cèdre.
fr.B: Il bâtit l’annexe contre tout le temple, chaque étage ayant {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de haut, et il la relia au temple par des poutres de cèdre.
fr.R: Il a construit les chambres latérales tout le long du temple. Chaque étage avait {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de haut. Des poutres de cèdre reliaient ce bâtiment au temple.

sw.L: Akajenga jengo la pembeni kuegemea nyumba yote, kimo chake dhiraa tano, nalo likashikamana na nyumba kwa miti ya mierezi.
sw.B: Akajenga jengo la pembeni kuegemea hekalu lote, kila ghorofa ikiwa na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, akaliunganisha na hekalu kwa boriti za mierezi.
sw.R: Alijenga vyumba vya pembeni kando ya hekalu lote. Kila ghorofa ilikuwa na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}. Boriti za mierezi ziliunganisha jengo hilo na hekalu.

vi.L: Vua xây dãy nhà phụ sát cả ngôi nhà, cao 5 cu-đê, và nó được gắn vào nhà bằng các đà gỗ bá hương.
vi.B: Vua xây dãy nhà phụ dọc theo toàn bộ đền thờ, mỗi tầng cao {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}, và nối dãy nhà ấy với đền thờ bằng các đà gỗ bá hương.
vi.R: Vua xây các phòng phụ dọc theo đền thờ. Mỗi tầng cao {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}. Các đà gỗ bá hương nối dãy nhà này với đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 온 집에 붙여 곁채를 지었는데, 그 높이가 다섯 규빗이었다. 그리고 그것은 백향목 재목으로 집에 붙어 있었다.
ko.B: 그는 성전 전체에 붙여 곁채를 지었는데, 각 층의 높이는 {{units:약 2.25미터|다섯 규빗}}이었다. 그리고 백향목 들보로 곁채를 성전에 연결했다.
ko.R: 그는 성전 둘레를 따라 곁방들을 지었다. 각 층의 높이는 {{units:약 2.25미터|다섯 규빗}}이었다. 백향목 들보가 이 건물을 성전에 이어 주었다.

pt.L: E construiu a estrutura lateral junto a toda a casa, cinco côvados a sua altura, e ela se prendia à casa com madeiras de cedro.
pt.B: Ele construiu a estrutura lateral junto a todo o templo, cada andar com {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de altura, e a prendeu ao templo com vigas de cedro.
pt.R: Ele construiu as salas laterais em toda a volta do templo. Cada andar tinha {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de altura. Vigas de cedro prendiam esse prédio ao templo.

decisions.choice: five cubits its height: the height of each story
alternatives: the height of the whole side structure
decisions.reason: With three stories (verse 6), five cubits is the height of each story, not of the whole structure. The Hebrew says only "five cubits its height".

decisions.choice: it held the house: the side structure was joined to the temple
decisions.reason: The verb means "take hold of". The subject may be Solomon ("he fastened it") or the side structure; either way the annex was joined to the temple by cedar beams resting on the ledges of verse 6.

decisions.choice: each story (Balanced); each floor (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the height is that of each story, following meaning decision m2.

records.literal_gloss: The house the this which you [are] building, if you will walk in my statutes, and my judgments you will do, and you will keep all my commandments to walk in them, and I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father,

en.L: "[As for] this house which you are building: if you walk in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and do {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} judgments and keep all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments, walking in them, then I will establish {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} word with you, which I spoke to David your father,
en.B: "As for this house you are building, if you live by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes, carry out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rulings and keep all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments by following them, I will carry out through you the word I gave to David your father,
en.R: "You are building this temple. If you follow {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws, obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rules, and keep all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands, then I will do for you what I promised your father David.

es.L: «[En cuanto a] esta casa que estás edificando, si andas en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y pones por obra {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} decretos, y guardas todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos andando en ellos, yo confirmaré contigo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} palabra que hablé a David tu padre,
es.B: «En cuanto a esta casa que estás edificando, si vives según {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos, cumples {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas y guardas todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos siguiéndolos, yo cumpliré por medio de ti la palabra que le di a tu padre David,
es.R: «Estás construyendo este templo. Si sigues {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes, obedeces {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas y guardas todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos, entonces haré por ti lo que le prometí a tu padre David.

fr.L: « Cette maison que tu bâtis : si tu marches selon {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions, et pratiques {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jugements, et gardes tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements en marchant selon eux, j’accomplirai avec toi {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} parole, que j’ai dite à David ton père,
fr.B: « Quant à cette maison que tu bâtis, si tu suis {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions, si tu appliques {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles et si tu gardes tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements en les mettant en pratique, j’accomplirai par toi la parole que j’ai donnée à David ton père,
fr.R: « Tu construis ce temple. Si tu suis {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois, si tu obéis à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles et si tu gardes tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements, alors je ferai pour toi ce que j’ai promis à ton père David.

sw.R: "Wewe unajenga hekalu hili. Ukifuata sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, ukatii kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, na kushika amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} zote, nitakutendea yale niliyomwahidi baba yako Daudi.

vi.L: "[Về] nhà này mà ngươi đang xây: nếu ngươi bước đi theo các luật lệ Ta, làm theo các phán quyết Ta, và giữ mọi điều răn Ta mà bước đi theo, thì Ta sẽ làm vững lời Ta với ngươi, là lời Ta đã phán với Đa-vít cha ngươi,
vi.B: "Về ngôi nhà con đang xây, nếu con sống theo các luật lệ Ta, thi hành các phán quyết Ta và giữ mọi điều răn Ta mà làm theo, thì Ta sẽ thực hiện qua con lời Ta đã phán với Đa-vít cha con,
vi.R: "Con đang xây đền thờ này. Nếu con làm theo các luật lệ Ta, vâng giữ các phán quyết Ta, và giữ mọi điều răn Ta, thì Ta sẽ làm cho con những gì Ta đã hứa với Đa-vít cha con.

ko.L: "네가 짓고 있는 이 집에 대하여 말한다. 만일 네가 내 규례대로 걷고 내 법도를 행하며 내 모든 계명을 지켜 그대로 걸으면, 내가 네 아버지 다윗에게 말한 내 말을 너와 함께 이룰 것이다.
ko.B: "네가 짓고 있는 이 성전에 대하여 말한다. 네가 내 규례대로 살고 내 법도를 실천하며 내 모든 계명을 지켜 그대로 행하면, 내가 네 아버지 다윗에게 한 말을 너를 통하여 이룰 것이다.
ko.R: "너는 지금 이 성전을 짓고 있다. 네가 내 법을 따르고 내 규칙을 지키고 내 모든 명령을 지키면, 내가 네 아버지 다윗에게 약속한 것을 너에게 이루어 주겠다.

pt.L: "[Quanto a] esta casa que tu estás construindo: se andares nos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos, e praticares as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} ordenanças, e guardares todos os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos, andando neles, então confirmarei contigo a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} palavra, que falei a Davi, teu pai,
pt.B: "Quanto a esta casa que estás construindo, se viveres segundo os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos, cumprires as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} ordenanças e guardares todos os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos, seguindo-os, cumprirei por meio de ti a palavra que dei a Davi, teu pai,
pt.R: "Tu estás construindo este templo. Se seguires as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} leis, obedeceres às {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} regras e guardares todos os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos, então farei por ti o que prometi ao teu pai Davi.

decisions.choice: this house which you are building: the subject the promise is set beside
decisions.reason: The sentence begins with the house and then breaks off into a condition about Solomon's life. The effect is to set the building beside obedience: the house matters, but the promise depends on keeping Yahweh's commands.

decisions.choice: statutes, judgments, commandments: the whole of Yahweh's law
decisions.reason: The three words together cover all that Yahweh commanded, as in Deuteronomy 5:31 and 1 Kings 2:3. "Walk in" means to live by them.

decisions.choice: my word which I spoke to David: the promise of a lasting house and throne
decisions.reason: Yahweh promised David that his son would build a house for his name and that his throne would last (2 Samuel 7:12-16). David passed on the condition to Solomon (2:4). Here Yahweh repeats it while the temple is being built.

decisions.choice: and I will establish: the result of the condition
decisions.reason: The "and" introduces what follows if Solomon obeys: "then I will establish".

decisions.choice: statutes, judgments, commandments (Literal); statutes, rulings, commandments (Balanced); laws, rules, commands (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus and Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: carry out the word I gave (Balanced); do what I promised (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Establish my word" means to make a promise stand by carrying it out; Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: estatutos, ordenanças, mandamentos (L, B); leis, regras, mandamentos (R)
decisions.reason: The three words for the whole law (m2) take the Old Testament terms: "o estatuto", "a ordenança", "o mandamento". Readable says "leis" and "regras" as the English Readable does, and keeps "mandamentos", the plain Portuguese word for God's commands. God speaks to Solomon with "tu", as in 3:5-14 in Portuguese.
